# RoyalAlert Project Instructions

RoyalAlert is a lightweight Vanilla JavaScript alert, toast, modal, and prompt notification library developed by Royal Technologies.

Project principles:
- Use Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+).
- Do not introduce jQuery or Bootstrap or any external dependencies.
- Preserve the public `RoyalAlert` global object API.
- Maintain backward compatibility where possible.
- Keep bundle size small.
- Use semantic and accessible HTML.
- Prefer Promise-based APIs for asynchronous operations.
- CSS should use `--ra-*` variables.

The official documentation and demo is:
https://royal-technologies.github.io/RoyalAlert/

The official repository is:
https://github.com/Royal-Technologies/RoyalAlert
